projects.title: More metres out the door, without a new line
projects.description: The plant needed more throughput and a higher dispatch top line, and the organisation was resisting the change. Rajesh ran a large-scale interactive process so leadership and the floor could agree the vision and the action plan. That was followed by lean manufacturing, structured problem solving, and process re-engineering on the line.
achievements: Throughput from 12,000 to 16,500 metres a day
Monthly unit-dispatch top line from ₹5 crore to ₹8.9 crore
Change programme designed so the line could run the new way, not only hear it

projects.title: Stop the loss that was sitting in finishing
projects.description: Finishing loss was eating yield on a plant that already knew how to make paper. The work was on the operation itself: find where good output was being lost, and hold the gain.
achievements: Improvement made inside the existing operation, not by adding a new line

projects.title: A daily rhythm for dispatch and fabric quality
projects.description: Throughput and machine efficiency were the commercial problem. Quality reprocessing was hiding inside the same system. Rajesh helped put a daily monitoring and order-dispatch system in place, and traced the root causes of reprocessing and poor fabric quality.
achievements: Higher throughput and better machine efficiency
Daily monitoring and an order-dispatch system the team could run
Root-cause work on reprocessing and poor fabric quality

projects.title: A shorter path from source to store
projects.client: Major organised fruit and vegetable retailer
projects.description: Lead time and supply-chain efficiency were limiting how fast fresh product could move. Rajesh developed a backward-integration strategy, and used market and trend analysis to shape the growth plan — not only the warehouse layout.
achievements: Backward integration to improve supply-chain efficiency
Growth strategy grounded in market and trend analysis

projects.title: See the operation before the decision is locked
projects.client: German manufacturer of heavy road-construction equipment
projects.description: Before a transaction, the operating reality has to be as clear as the financials. Rajesh led the operations due diligence — where the risk actually sits on the floor, not only in the data room.
achievements: Operations due diligence for a cross-border industrial business
A view of operating risk that a spreadsheet review does not give
